intro: Kuwait is an emirate ruled by the Al Sabah family, which for decades had one of the Gulf's liveliest elected parliaments.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The emir appoints the prime minister. The National Assembly, elected since 1963, could question ministers and block laws. In May 2024 the emir suspended parliament and parts of the constitution for up to four years.

chapters.title: Votes for women
text: Women won the right to vote and stand for parliament in 2005.

items.title: Decree
items.text: While parliament is suspended, laws are issued by decree.
